continuity.campaign_development: April 60 BCE: Valerius continued deeper into the bandit-controlled interior and actively exploited captured watching-post intelligence. He bypassed known ambush corridors, recovered another hidden store, used a deliberately abandoned trail to misdirect a search party, and disrupted a communications crossing without a pitched battle. Intelligence rose to 957, supply to 50, exhaustion rose to 55, relations fell to 97, while stability and legitimacy remained 100. Land area remained 4.00 square miles.
